deliverables: Milestone-based disbursement controls through Intersect treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor Teragone via TRSC and PSSC.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continuous development and Intersect budget administration.

claims.claim: Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way, enabling rapid state verification without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal states that full node synchronization is slow and light clients rely on centralized trust today.
The requested 3,810,423 ada consists of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not at submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs.
Teragone has worked on Mithril for several years through collaboration with IOG, which has funded the project to date.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is provided for the community to audit the TRSC or PSSC and track metrics related to the withdrawn ada.
Mithril enables community-built tools such as bridges, light wallets, full wallets, light clients, and monitoring tools to emerge around Cardano.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril Protocol continuous development and administration, frames Mithril as trustless Cardano state-certification infrastructure, cites Intersect budget-process approval and NCL compliance, and describes smart-contract custody, oversight, and dashboard-based auditability.
